en_us: Rotation does the work: from a water wheel to a wall of crafters.
es_es: La rotación hace el trabajo: de una rueda hidráulica a una pared de ensambladores.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

en_us.title: Andesite Alloy
en_us.subtitle: Create's duct tape.
text: [lead] Half of early Create starts right here.
[li:minecraft:iron_nugget] [item:minecraft:andesite|Andesite] and [item:minecraft:iron_nugget|iron nuggets] in a 2×2 checkerboard: one alloy.
[li:create:andesite_alloy] It builds shafts, casings, belts and most early machines.
[tip] Later a [item:create:mechanical_mixer|Mechanical Mixer] makes it from one of each: half price.

es_es.title: Aleación de andesita
es_es.subtitle: El Poxipol de Create.
text: [lead] Medio Create temprano arranca por acá.
[li:minecraft:iron_nugget] [item:minecraft:andesite|Andesita] y [item:minecraft:iron_nugget|pepitas de hierro] en damero de 2×2: una aleación.
[li:create:andesite_alloy] De acá salen ejes, revestimientos, cintas y casi todas las primeras máquinas.
[tip] Más adelante una [item:create:mechanical_mixer|Mezcladora mecánica] la hace con una de cada: a mitad de precio.

en_us.title: Ponder it
en_us.subtitle: The manual that moves.
text: [tip] Hover any Create block and hold [key:key.ponder.ponder].
An animated scene shows how it works, step by step. The addons have scenes too.

es_es.title: Ponderalo
es_es.subtitle: El manual que se mueve.
text: [tip] Pasá el mouse por cualquier bloque de Create y mantené [key:key.ponder.ponder].
Una escena animada muestra cómo funciona, paso a paso. Los addons también tienen.

en_us.title: Shafts and cogs
text: [lead] Rotation travels through these.
[li] Two alloys stacked: eight [item:create:shaft|Shafts]. They carry rotation straight.
[li] A shaft and a plank: a [item:create:cogwheel|Cogwheel]. It turns its neighbour the other way.
[tip] Machine running backwards? Add or remove one cog.

es_es.title: Ejes y engranajes
text: [lead] Por acá viaja la rotación.
[li] Dos aleaciones, una arriba de otra: ocho [item:create:shaft|Ejes]. Llevan la rotación derecho.
[li] Un eje y un tablón: un [item:create:cogwheel|Engranaje]. Hace girar al vecino al revés.
[tip] ¿La máquina anda para atrás? Sumá o sacá un engranaje.

en_us.title: Shifting gears
text: [lead] Mesh a [item:create:large_cogwheel|Large Cogwheel] diagonally with a small one.
[li] Big to small: [hl|twice] the speed.
[li] Small to big: [hl|half] the speed.
Faster machines eat more stress: speed up only what needs it.

es_es.title: Cambio de marcha
text: [lead] Engraná en diagonal un [item:create:large_cogwheel|Engranaje grande] con uno chico.
[li] De grande a chico: [hl|el doble] de velocidad.
[li] De chico a grande: [hl|la mitad].
Más rápido también come más estrés: aceleralo sólo donde haga falta.

en_us.title: Elbow grease
en_us.subtitle: The first engine is you.
text: [lead] Three planks and an alloy: a [item:create:hand_crank|Hand Crank].
Hold [icon:right_click] right-click on it and the machine on the other end turns, for as long as your arm lasts.

es_es.title: A pulmón
es_es.subtitle: El primer motor sos vos.
text: [lead] Tres tablones y una aleación: una [item:create:hand_crank|Manivela].
Mantené [icon:right_click] clic derecho y la máquina del otro lado gira, mientras te aguante el brazo.

en_us.title: Let the river work
text: [lead] Free, steady, silent power.
[li] Eight planks around a [item:create:shaft|Shaft].
[li] It spins in flowing water: a river, a waterfall, a short stream.
[li] More water on more sides adds nothing. More wheels do.
[note] Any plank reskins it.

es_es.title: Que el río trabaje
text: [lead] Energía gratis, pareja y silenciosa.
[li] Ocho tablones alrededor de un [item:create:shaft|Eje].
[li] Gira con agua que corre: un río, una cascada, un arroyito.
[li] Más agua en más lados no suma. Más ruedas, sí.
[note] Cualquier tablón le cambia la madera.

en_us.title: Bigger, slower, stronger
text: [lead] Planks around a [item:create:water_wheel|Water Wheel] make the large one.
[li] [hl|Half] the speed.
[li] [hl|Much more] stress capacity.
[tip] A large-to-small cog step wins the speed back.

es_es.title: Más grande, más lenta, más fuerte
text: [lead] Tablones alrededor de una [item:create:water_wheel|Rueda hidráulica mecánica] dan la grande.
[li] [hl|Mitad] de velocidad.
[li] [hl|Mucha más] capacidad de estrés.
[tip] Un paso de engranaje grande a chico recupera la velocidad.

en_us.title: Where the water isn't
text: [lead] A [item:create:windmill_bearing|Windmill Bearing] turns wind into rotation.
[li] It spins a glued structure with at least [hl|8] sail blocks. Sails stick without glue.
[li] [icon:right_click] Right-click it to start or stop.
[li] More sails, more speed.

es_es.title: Donde no hay agua
text: [lead] Un [item:create:windmill_bearing|Rodamiento de molino de viento] hace del viento rotación.
[li] Gira una estructura pegada con al menos [hl|8] bloques de vela. Las velas se pegan solas.
[li] [icon:right_click] Clic derecho para arrancar o parar.
[li] Más velas, más velocidad.

en_us.title: Hot wheels
en_us.subtitle: This shouldn't have worked.
text: [lead] Lava turns a [item:create:water_wheel|Water Wheel] too.
Nobody in Heliodor wrote that down, and there was a reason.

es_es.title: Ruedas calientes
es_es.subtitle: Esto no tendría que haber andado.
text: [lead] La lava también hace girar una [item:create:water_wheel|Rueda hidráulica mecánica].
En Heliodor nadie lo anotó, y por algo habrá sido.

en_us.title: Dress the wood
text: [lead] [icon:right_click] Right-click stripped logs or wood with [item:create:andesite_alloy|Andesite Alloy].
Press, mixer, fan, millstone, drill, saw, bearing and gearbox all wear it.
[tip] A [item:create:deployer|Deployer] applies it for you later.

es_es.title: Vestir la madera
text: [lead] [icon:right_click] Clic derecho con [item:create:andesite_alloy|Aleación de andesita] sobre troncos o madera sin corteza.
Prensa, mezcladora, ventilador, muela, taladro, sierra, rodamiento y caja de transmisión lo llevan puesto.
[tip] Más adelante un [item:create:deployer|Desplegador] lo aplica por vos.

en_us.title: Round the corner
en_us.subtitle: Cleaner than cog spaghetti.
text: [lead] One block that turns rotation round corners.
[li] Four cogs around an [item:create:andesite_casing|Andesite Casing].
[li] Side outputs mirror each other.
[li] The straight-through side runs [hl|reversed].

es_es.title: A la vuelta de la esquina
es_es.subtitle: Más prolijo que un espagueti de engranajes.
text: [lead] Un bloque que dobla la rotación en las esquinas.
[li] Cuatro engranajes alrededor de un [item:create:andesite_casing|Revestimiento de Andesita].
[li] Las salidas laterales son espejo.
[li] La de enfrente gira [hl|al revés].

en_us.title: Flat out
en_us.subtitle: Ingots in, pancakes out.
text: [lead] A [item:create:mechanical_press|Mechanical Press] flattens what sits below it.
[li] An item on the ground, on a [item:create:depot|Depot] or riding a belt.
[li:create:iron_sheet] Ingots come out as sheets.
Over a [item:create:basin|Basin] it compacts instead: [hl|2×2] and [hl|3×3] recipes, no hands.

es_es.title: A la plancha
es_es.subtitle: Entran lingotes, salen panqueques.
text: [lead] La [item:create:mechanical_press|Prensa mecánica] aplasta lo que tiene abajo.
[li] Un ítem en el piso, en un [item:create:depot|Depósito] o sobre una cinta.
[li:create:iron_sheet] Los lingotes salen láminas.
Sobre una [item:create:basin|Cuenca] compacta: recetas de [hl|2×2] y [hl|3×3], sin manos.

en_us.title: Belts
text: [lead] Six dried kelp: a [item:create:belt_connector|Mechanical Belt].
[li] Click two shafts to link them, [hl|2 to 20] blocks apart, even on a slope.
[li] It carries items and mobs.
[li] Machines above work on what rides past.

es_es.title: Cintas
text: [lead] Seis kelp seco: una [item:create:belt_connector|Cinta mecánica].
[li] Clic en dos ejes para unirlos, de [hl|2 a 20] bloques, incluso en pendiente.
[li] Lleva ítems y mobs.
[li] Las máquinas de arriba trabajan lo que pasa.

en_us.title: In and out
text: [lead] An [item:create:andesite_funnel|Andesite Funnel] moves items in or out.
[li] Placed normally, it pulls from an inventory.
[li] Placed while sneaking, it pushes into it.
A [item:create:depot|Depot] is a one-slot belt for machines and arms.
[careful] Funnels can't join two chests directly: put a chute or a belt between them.

es_es.title: Entra y sale
text: [lead] Un [item:create:andesite_funnel|Embudo de andesita] mete o saca ítems.
[li] Puesto normal, saca de un inventario.
[li] Puesto agachado, mete.
Un [item:create:depot|Depósito] es una cinta de un solo lugar para máquinas y brazos.
[careful] Dos cofres no se unen con embudos solos: poné un ducto o una cinta en el medio.

en_us.title: Down the chute
text: [lead] [item:create:chute|Chutes] drop items straight down between inventories.
An [item:create:encased_fan|Encased Fan] at one end sends them [hl|up] instead.

es_es.title: Por el ducto
text: [lead] Los [item:create:chute|Ductos] bajan ítems derecho entre inventarios.
Con un [item:create:encased_fan|Ventilador revestido] en una punta, los [hl|suben].

en_us.title: The big box
en_us.subtitle: No peeking.
text: [lead] The perfect buffer between machines.
[li] [item:create:item_vault|Item Vaults] merge up to [hl|3 wide] and hold a lot.
[li] No hand opens them: funnels, chutes and arms do.

es_es.title: La caja grande
es_es.subtitle: Prohibido espiar.
text: [lead] El colchón ideal entre máquinas.
[li] Las [item:create:item_vault|Bóvedas de objetos] se unen hasta [hl|3 de ancho] y guardan mucho.
[li] Ninguna mano las abre: embudos, ductos y brazos sí.

en_us.title: Read the strain
text: [lead] See the stress, then fix it.
[li:create:goggles] [item:create:goggles|Engineer's Goggles] show every machine's stress.
[li:create:wrench] A [item:create:wrench|Wrench] turns parts and, sneaking, picks them up whole.
[note] The goggles need a golden sheet: the press makes it.

es_es.title: Leer el esfuerzo
text: [lead] Mirá el estrés, después arreglalo.
[li:create:goggles] Las [item:create:goggles|Gafas del ingeniero] muestran el estrés de cada máquina.
[li:create:wrench] La [item:create:wrench|Llave inglesa] gira piezas y, agachado, las levanta enteras.
[note] Las gafas piden una lámina de oro: la prensa la hace.

en_us.title: Stress is the budget
text: [tip] Sources add [hover|stress capacity|Counted in su (stress units). Engineer's Goggles show it.]; machines spend it, more the faster they spin.
[careful] [b|Overspend] and the whole network stops.
Any of these fixes it:
[li] More sources.
[li] Slower machines.
[li] Two networks.

es_es.title: El estrés es el presupuesto
text: [tip] Las fuentes suman [hover|capacidad de estrés|Se mide en su (unidades de estrés). Las gafas de ingeniero la muestran.]; las máquinas la gastan, más cuanto más rápido giran.
[careful] [b|Si te pasás], se frena toda la red.
Cualquiera de estas lo arregla:
[li] Más fuentes.
[li] Máquinas más lentas.
[li] Dos redes.

en_us.title: Wireless, the old way
text: [lead] Two items in its slots set a [item:create:redstone_link|Redstone Link]'s frequency.
Links with the same pair talk across [big|256] blocks.
Sneak-click swaps sender and receiver.
[tip] A link driving a [item:create:clutch|Clutch] is the tidiest remote off switch.

es_es.title: Inalámbrico, a la antigua
text: [lead] Dos ítems en sus ranuras fijan la frecuencia de un [item:create:redstone_link|Enlace de redstone].
Los que tienen el mismo par se hablan a [big|256] bloques.
Agachado y clic cambia entre emisor y receptor.
[tip] Un enlace que maneja un [item:create:clutch|Embrague] es el apagado a distancia más prolijo.

en_us.title: Stir it up
text: [lead] A [item:create:mechanical_mixer|Mechanical Mixer] over a [item:create:basin|Basin] runs shapeless recipes.
Create mixing too: alloys, dough, liquids.
Results leave by the basin's outlet into an inventory below or beside.
[tip] Two recipes match? A filter on the mixer picks one.

es_es.title: Revolviendo
text: [lead] Una [item:create:mechanical_mixer|Mezcladora mecánica] sobre una [item:create:basin|Cuenca] hace recetas sin forma.
Y las mezclas de Create: aleaciones, masa, líquidos.
Lo que sale va por la salida de la cuenca a un inventario abajo o al costado.
[tip] ¿Coinciden dos recetas? Un filtro en la mezcladora elige cuál.

en_us.title: Hot air
text: [lead] An [item:create:encased_fan|Encased Fan] pushes or pulls air by its spin.
It drags items and mobs along.
A catalyst block in the stream processes whatever flies through.

es_es.title: Aire caliente
text: [lead] Un [item:create:encased_fan|Ventilador revestido] empuja o chupa aire según su giro.
Arrastra ítems y mobs.
Un bloque catalizador en la corriente procesa lo que vuela por ahí.

en_us.title: Catalysts
text: [tip] What sits in the stream decides the job:
[li:minecraft:lava_bucket] Lava or a lit [name:block.create.blaze_burner]: [hl|smelts].
[li:minecraft:campfire] Fire: [hl|smokes].
[li:minecraft:water_bucket] Water: [hl|washes].
[li:minecraft:soul_campfire] Soul fire: [hl|haunts].
[careful] Food in lava burns: smoke it instead.
Fan speed changes the reach, not the time.

es_es.title: Catalizadores
text: [tip] Lo que haya en la corriente decide el trabajo:
[li:minecraft:lava_bucket] Lava o un [name:block.create.blaze_burner] prendido: [hl|funde].
[li:minecraft:campfire] Fuego: [hl|ahúma].
[li:minecraft:water_bucket] Agua: [hl|lava].
[li:minecraft:soul_campfire] Fuego de almas: [hl|embruja].
[careful] La comida en lava se quema: ahumala.
La velocidad cambia el alcance, no el tiempo.

en_us.title: Grind, slowly
text: [lead] A [item:create:millstone|Millstone] grinds what you feed it from the top.
[li:minecraft:flint] Gravel into flint.
[li:create:wheat_flour] Wheat into flour.
[li:minecraft:red_dye] Flowers into dye.
Slow and cheap; crushing wheels do it better later.

es_es.title: Moler, despacio
text: [lead] Una [item:create:millstone|Muela] muele lo que le cargás por arriba.
[li:minecraft:flint] Grava en pedernal.
[li:create:wheat_flour] Trigo en harina.
[li:minecraft:red_dye] Flores en tinte.
Lenta y barata; después las ruedas trituradoras lo hacen mejor.

en_us.title: Fire in a cage
en_us.subtitle: Blaze, meet your new job.
text: [lead] Iron sheets and netherrack make an empty [item:create:blaze_burner|Blaze Burner].
[icon:right_click] Right-click a Blaze or its spawner to fill it.
[li:minecraft:coal] Fed fuel, it [hl|heats] the basin above.
[li:create:blaze_cake] Fed a [item:create:blaze_cake|Blaze Cake], it [hl|superheats].

es_es.title: Fuego enjaulado
es_es.subtitle: Blaze: conseguiste laburo.
text: [lead] Láminas de hierro y netherrack hacen un [item:create:blaze_burner|Quemador de Blaze] vacío.
[icon:right_click] Clic derecho a un Blaze o a su generador para llenarlo.
[li:minecraft:coal] Con combustible, [hl|calienta] la cuenca de arriba.
[li:create:blaze_cake] Con un [item:create:blaze_cake|Pastel de blaze], la [hl|sobrecalienta].

en_us.title: Pipes and pumps
text: [lead] Copper on stripped wood gives [item:create:copper_casing|Copper Casing].
A cog on a [item:create:fluid_pipe|Fluid Pipe] makes a [item:create:mechanical_pump|Mechanical Pump].
[careful] Its arrow, not the rotation, sets which way the fluid goes.

es_es.title: Caños y bombas
text: [lead] Cobre sobre madera sin corteza da [item:create:copper_casing|Revestimiento de Cobre].
Un engranaje en una [item:create:fluid_pipe|Tubería de fluidos] hace una [item:create:mechanical_pump|Bomba mecánica].
[careful] La flecha, no el giro, decide para dónde va el fluido.

en_us.title: Tanks
text: [lead] [item:create:fluid_tank|Fluid Tanks] merge into one big tank.
[li] Up to [hl|3×3] wide and over [hl|30] tall.
[li] A comparator reads the level.
[careful] Hands can't pour into them: use a basin, a spout or an item drain.
[tip] A [item:create:hose_pulley|Hose Pulley] in a big enough lake pumps forever.

es_es.title: Tanques
text: [lead] Los [item:create:fluid_tank|Depósitos de fluidos] se unen en uno grande.
[li] Hasta [hl|3×3] de ancho y más de [hl|30] de alto.
[li] Un comparador lee el nivel.
[careful] A mano no se llenan: usá una cuenca, un surtidor o un escurridor.
[tip] Una [item:create:hose_pulley|Polea de manguera] en un lago grande bombea para siempre.

en_us.title: Full steam
en_us.subtitle: The whistle is optional. Mostly.
text: [lead] A boiler, in three parts:
[li] [item:create:steam_engine|Steam Engines] on a tank.
[li] Burners below.
[li] Water piped in.
Each boiler level runs one more engine at full power; the goggles say what's missing.

es_es.title: A todo vapor
es_es.subtitle: El silbato es opcional. Casi.
text: [lead] Una caldera, en tres partes:
[li] [item:create:steam_engine|Motores de vapor] sobre un tanque.
[li] Quemadores abajo.
[li] Agua por caño.
Cada nivel de caldera mueve un motor más a pleno; las gafas dicen qué falta.

en_us.title: Pipe dream
en_us.subtitle: The neighbours have opinions.
text: [lead] Twelve [item:create:steam_whistle|Steam Whistles], twelve pitches, one tank.
Heliodor's copper had a sound; now yours does too.

es_es.title: Órgano de caños
es_es.subtitle: Los vecinos tienen opiniones.
text: [lead] Doce [item:create:steam_whistle|Silbatos de vapor], doce notas, un tanque.
El cobre de Heliodor tenía un sonido; ahora el tuyo también.

en_us.title: Down to brass tacks
text: [lead] Brass opens the second age.
One copper and one [item:create:zinc_ingot|Zinc Ingot] in a heated basin give [big|2] [item:create:brass_ingot|Brass Ingots].
Zinc ore spawns in the Overworld.
[li] Smart logistics, deployers, arms, crafters.
[li] And the [chapter:sector_create_addons|addons].

es_es.title: Al grano, de latón
text: [lead] El latón abre la segunda época.
Un cobre y un [item:create:zinc_ingot|Lingote de cinc] en una cuenca caliente dan [big|2] [item:create:brass_ingot|Lingotes de latón].
El cinc aparece en el Overworld.
[li] Logística con criterio, desplegadores, brazos, ensambladores.
[li] Y los [chapter:sector_create_addons|addons].

en_us.title: Pink and polished
text: [lead] One quartz and eight redstone: [item:create:rose_quartz|Rose Quartz].
[li:create:sand_paper] Polish it with [item:create:sand_paper|Sand Paper] in one hand and the quartz in the other.
[li:create:polished_rose_quartz] Or leave it to a deployer.

es_es.title: Rosado y pulido
text: [lead] Un cuarzo y ocho redstone: [item:create:rose_quartz|Cuarzo rosado].
[li:create:sand_paper] Pulilo con [item:create:sand_paper|Papel de lija] en una mano y el cuarzo en la otra.
[li:create:polished_rose_quartz] O dejáselo a un desplegador.

en_us.title: The brass jacket
text: [lead] The body of every smart machine.
[icon:right_click] A [item:create:brass_ingot|Brass Ingot] on stripped wood.
Crafters, arms, tunnels and the speed controller all wear it.

es_es.title: La chaqueta de latón
text: [lead] El cuerpo de toda máquina inteligente.
[icon:right_click] Un [item:create:brass_ingot|Lingote de latón] sobre madera sin corteza.
Ensambladores, brazos, túneles y el controlador de velocidad lo llevan.

en_us.title: Picky funnels
text: [lead] A [item:create:brass_funnel|Brass Funnel] moves:
[li] whole stacks,
[li] exact amounts,
[li] only what its filter lets through.
A [item:create:brass_tunnel|Brass Tunnel] on a belt filters each side: blocks what comes in, sorts what goes out.

es_es.title: Embudos exigentes
text: [lead] Un [item:create:brass_funnel|Embudo de latón] mueve:
[li] stacks enteros,
[li] cantidades exactas,
[li] sólo lo que deja pasar su filtro.
Un [item:create:brass_tunnel|Túnel de latón] sobre una cinta filtra por lado: frena lo que entra, ordena lo que sale.

en_us.title: Tunnel modes
text: [tip] Tunnels on side-by-side belts join up.
[li] [b|Split] spreads a stack evenly.
[li] [b|Round Robin] cycles whole stacks.
[li] [b|Prefer Nearest] favours the closest exit.
[li] [b|Synchronize] waits for every belt.

es_es.title: Modos de túnel
text: [tip] Los túneles de cintas vecinas se juntan.
[li] [b|Dividir] reparte un stack parejo.
[li] [b|Round Robin] rota stacks enteros.
[li] [b|Preferir cercano] va a la salida más cerca.
[li] [b|Sincronizar] espera a todas las cintas.

en_us.title: Filters with taste
text: [lead] Either fits any Create filter slot.
[li:create:filter] A [item:create:filter|List Filter] matches a set of items.
[li:create:attribute_filter] An [item:create:attribute_filter|Attribute Filter] matches a property, like 'can be smelted' or a tag.

es_es.title: Filtros con criterio
text: [lead] Cualquiera entra en una ranura de filtro de Create.
[li:create:filter] Un [item:create:filter|Filtrador de Listas] acepta un grupo de ítems.
[li:create:attribute_filter] Un [item:create:attribute_filter|Filtro de atributos], una propiedad, como 'se puede fundir' o una etiqueta.

en_us.title: Stop when full
text: [lead] A [item:create:stockpile_switch|Threshold Switch] watches how full a box is.
It turns on above one fill level and off below another.
Wire it to a clutch and the machine rests when the chest is full.

es_es.title: Parar cuando se llena
text: [lead] Un [item:create:stockpile_switch|Interruptor de umbral] vigila qué tan lleno está un cofre.
Se prende arriba de un nivel de llenado y se apaga abajo de otro.
Conectalo a un embrague y la máquina descansa cuando el cofre está lleno.

en_us.title: Brains in a bulb
text: [lead] Every smart block carries one.
[icon:create:polished_rose_quartz] [item:create:polished_rose_quartz|Polished Rose Quartz] on an [item:create:iron_sheet|Iron Sheet].
Funnels, tunnels, deployers, crafters, observers.
[tip] Make a handful; they go fast.

es_es.title: Cerebro en una lamparita
text: [lead] Todo bloque inteligente lleva uno.
[icon:create:polished_rose_quartz] [item:create:polished_rose_quartz|Cuarzo rosado pulido] sobre una [item:create:iron_sheet|Lámina de hierro].
Embudos, túneles, desplegadores, ensambladores, observadores.
[tip] Hacé varios; vuelan.

en_us.title: Signs of life
text: [lead] A [item:create:display_link|Display Link] reads a source and writes it somewhere.
[li] Reads: stock, boiler, stress, train arrivals.
[li] Writes on: a [item:create:display_board|Display Board], a sign or nixie tubes.
[note] Click the display first, then place the link on the source.

es_es.title: Señales de vida
text: [lead] Un [item:create:display_link|Enlace de Visualización] lee una fuente y la escribe en otro lado.
[li] Lee: stock, caldera, estrés, llegadas de trenes.
[li] Escribe en: una [item:create:display_board|Pantalla de visualización], un cartel o tubos nixie.
[note] Primero clic en la pantalla, después poné el enlace en la fuente.

en_us.title: Launch, precisely
en_us.subtitle: Yeeting, but polite.
text: [lead] Anything set on a [item:create:weighted_ejector|Weighted Ejector] flies to the target.
Items, mobs, you.
[li] Sneak-click to aim it, then place it.
[li] Aimed at an inventory, it waits for room.

es_es.title: Lanzamiento de precisión
es_es.subtitle: Revolea, pero con modales.
text: [lead] Lo que se apoye en un [item:create:weighted_ejector|Eyector de peso] vuela al objetivo.
Ítems, mobs, vos.
[li] Agachado y clic para apuntarlo, y después ponelo.
[li] Si apunta a un inventario, espera lugar.

en_us.title: A second pair of hands
text: [lead] A [item:create:deployer|Deployer] is a mechanical you.
It places, uses, harvests and hits two blocks ahead.
With an item in hand, it works on whatever sits below on a depot or belt.

es_es.title: Otro par de manos
text: [lead] Un [item:create:deployer|Desplegador] es un vos mecánico.
Pone, usa, cosecha y pega dos bloques adelante.
Con un ítem en la mano, trabaja lo que esté abajo en un depósito o una cinta.

en_us.title: Assembly, in order
text: [tip] Some parts are built in steps.
The base becomes an unfinished item that passes a list of machines a set number of times.
A belt looping back to its start runs it hands-free.

es_es.title: Montaje en orden
text: [tip] Algunas piezas se arman por pasos.
La base se vuelve un ítem incompleto que recorre una lista de máquinas varias veces.
Una cinta que vuelve al principio lo hace sin manos.

en_us.title: One swing only
text: [tip] With a filter, a deployer only acts while holding the matching item.
Redstone stops it after the current swing: a short pulse gives [hl|exactly one] use.

es_es.title: Un solo golpe
text: [tip] Con filtro, el desplegador sólo actúa si tiene el ítem que coincide.
La redstone lo frena después del golpe en curso: un pulso corto da [hl|exactamente un] uso.

en_us.title: Pound it
en_us.subtitle: Solidarity among machines.
text: [lead] Two [item:create:deployer|Deployers] face to face, both punching.
Somewhere a union is forming.

es_es.title: Chocala
es_es.subtitle: Solidaridad entre máquinas.
text: [lead] Dos [item:create:deployer|Desplegadores] frente a frente, los dos pegando.
En algún lado se está armando un sindicato.

en_us.title: Precision work
text: [lead] Four in five come out right; the rest is scrap.
Start from a [item:create:golden_sheet|Golden Sheet] from the [quest:crb_press|press]. Then [big|5] loops of deployers add:
[li] a cogwheel,
[li] a large cogwheel,
[li:minecraft:iron_nugget] an iron nugget.
{page}
The result is a [item:create:precision_mechanism|Precision Mechanism]. Arms, speed controllers, train controls and two act components need it.

es_es.title: Trabajo de precisión
text: [lead] Cuatro de cada cinco salen bien; el resto, chatarra.
Arrancá con una [item:create:golden_sheet|Lámina de oro] de la [quest:crb_press|prensa]. Después, [big|5] vueltas de desplegadores le agregan:
[li] un engranaje,
[li] un engranaje grande,
[li:minecraft:iron_nugget] una pepita de hierro.
{page}
Sale un [item:create:precision_mechanism|Mecanismo de precisión]. Lo piden brazos, controladores de velocidad, controles de tren y dos componentes de acto.

en_us.title: Cruise control
text: [lead] Run a line at what the recipe needs, not a notch more.
A [item:create:rotation_speed_controller|Rotation Speed Controller] (brass casing and a precision mechanism) drives a large cog on top at the exact speed on its panel.

es_es.title: Control crucero
text: [lead] Una línea a lo que pide la receta, ni un punto más.
El [item:create:rotation_speed_controller|Controlador de velocidad rotacional] (revestimiento de latón y un mecanismo de precisión) mueve un engranaje grande arriba a la velocidad exacta de su panel.

en_us.title: Pick and place
text: [lead] Tell the [item:create:mechanical_arm|Mechanical Arm] where before you place it.
[li] Click its targets with it in hand: [b|blue] takes.
[li] Click again for [b|yellow], which gives.
Then it shuttles items between any number of them.

es_es.title: Agarrar y dejar
text: [lead] Decile al [item:create:mechanical_arm|Brazo mecánico] dónde, antes de ponerlo.
[li] Con él en la mano, clic en sus destinos: [b|azul] toma.
[li] Otro clic lo pasa a [b|amarillo], que entrega.
Después reparte ítems entre todos.

en_us.title: Arm etiquette
text: [tip] With several outputs, pick a mode:
[li] [b|Round Robin] cycles.
[li] [b|Forced Round Robin] waits for each.
[li] [b|Prefer First] fills the first.
Feeding blaze burners is the classic first job.

es_es.title: Modales de brazo
text: [tip] Con varias salidas, elegí un modo:
[li] [b|Round Robin] rota.
[li] [b|Round Robin forzado] espera a cada una.
[li] [b|Preferir primero] llena la primera.
Alimentar quemadores es el clásico primer trabajo.

en_us.title: Kitchen shift
text: [lead] Dinner, automated.
With Central Kitchen, Create runs Farmer's Delight pots, stoves and feasts.
The [item:sliceanddice:slicer|Slicer] does the knife work.

es_es.title: Turno de cocina
text: [lead] La cena, automática.
Con Central Kitchen, Create maneja ollas, cocinas y banquetes de Farmer's Delight.
La [item:sliceanddice:slicer|Rebanadora] se encarga del cuchillo.

en_us.title: DJ Arm
en_us.subtitle: Requests not accepted.
text: [lead] A [item:create:mechanical_arm|Mechanical Arm] working a jukebox.
It has one song and it loves it.

es_es.title: DJ Brazo
es_es.subtitle: No se aceptan pedidos.
text: [lead] Un [item:create:mechanical_arm|Brazo mecánico] manejando un tocadiscos.
Tiene un solo tema y lo ama.

en_us.title: Crafting, industrialised
text: [lead] A grid of them crafts any recipe, [hl|5×5] included.
A tube, a brass casing and a crafting table make [big|3] [item:create:mechanical_crafter|Mechanical Crafters].
[tip] Wrench their arrows so every path ends at one exit.

es_es.title: La mesa, industrializada
text: [lead] En grilla fabrican cualquier receta, incluso de [hl|5×5].
Un tubo, un revestimiento de latón y una mesa de trabajo dan [big|3] [item:create:mechanical_crafter|Ensambladores mecánicos].
[tip] Girá sus flechas con la llave para que todo termine en una salida.

en_us.title: Fill 'er up
text: [lead] A pipe-fed [item:create:spout|Spout] fills what sits below.
Buckets, bottles, potions, honey. An [item:create:item_drain|Item Drain] does the opposite.
[tip] Spout lava onto [item:create:powdered_obsidian|Powdered Obsidian] and press it twice: [item:create:sturdy_sheet|Sturdy Sheets], where [chapter:sector_create_logistics|trains] begin.

es_es.title: Lleno, por favor
text: [lead] Un [item:create:spout|Surtidor] con caño llena lo que tenga abajo.
Baldes, botellas, pociones, miel. El [item:create:item_drain|Escurridor] hace lo contrario.

[tip] Echale lava con el surtidor al [item:create:powdered_obsidian|Polvo de obsidiana] y prensalo dos veces: [item:create:sturdy_sheet|láminas robustas], donde empiezan los [chapter:sector_create_logistics|trenes].

en_us.title: Cake for the blaze
en_us.subtitle: The cake is not a lie.
text: [lead] Some recipes demand a superheated burner.
[li:create:blaze_cake_base] Compact egg, sugar and [item:create:cinder_flour|Cinder Flour] into a base.
[li:create:blaze_cake] A spout fills it with [hl|250 mB] of lava: a [item:create:blaze_cake|Blaze Cake].
Fed one, a burner superheats.

es_es.title: Torta para el blaze
es_es.subtitle: La torta no es mentira.
text: [lead] Algunas recetas exigen un quemador sobrecalentado.
[li:create:blaze_cake_base] Compactá huevo, azúcar y [item:create:cinder_flour|Harina del Nether] en una base.
[li:create:blaze_cake] Un surtidor la llena con [hl|250 mB] de lava: un [item:create:blaze_cake|Pastel de blaze].
Si come uno, el quemador se sobrecalienta.

en_us.title: Alloy run
en_us.subtitle: Same time tomorrow?
text: [lead] For the common store, once a day.
[big|32] [item:create:andesite_alloy|Andesite Alloy].
A mixer on a belt makes this a coffee break.

es_es.title: Tanda de aleación
es_es.subtitle: ¿Mañana a la misma hora?
text: [lead] Para el depósito común, una vez por día.
[big|32] de [item:create:andesite_alloy|Aleación de andesita].
Con una mezcladora sobre una cinta, esto es un recreo.

en_us.title: The big grind
en_us.subtitle: It takes twenty-five crafters.
text: [lead] Two wheels that chew whatever falls between them.
A [hl|5×5] mechanical recipe of [item:create:andesite_alloy|Andesite Alloy], planks and stone makes a pair of [item:create:crushing_wheel|Crushing Wheels].
Side by side, spinning into each other.
{page}
{image:entrelumen:textures/gui/quests/diagram_crushing.png width:96 height:48 align:center}
[li:create:crushed_raw_iron] Raw ore comes out crushed, with bonus nuggets and a chance of XP.
[li:create:cinder_flour] Netherrack becomes [item:create:cinder_flour|Cinder Flour].
[good|Faster wheels, faster grind.]

es_es.title: La gran molienda
es_es.subtitle: Hacen falta veinticinco ensambladores.
text: [lead] Dos ruedas que mastican lo que les cae en el medio.
Una receta mecánica de [hl|5×5] con [item:create:andesite_alloy|Aleación de andesita], tablones y piedra da un par de [item:create:crushing_wheel|Ruedas trituradoras].
Una al lado de la otra, girando hacia adentro.
{page}
{image:entrelumen:textures/gui/quests/diagram_crushing.png width:96 height:48 align:center}
[li:create:crushed_raw_iron] La mena sale triturada, con pepitas de más y chance de experiencia.
[li:create:cinder_flour] El netherrack da [item:create:cinder_flour|Harina del Nether].
[good|Ruedas más rápidas, molienda más rápida.]

en_us.title: Ore arithmetic
text: [tip] One raw iron, one crushed iron, plus [hl|75%] of an XP nugget.
[li:minecraft:iron_ingot] Smelt it: an ingot.
[li:minecraft:iron_nugget] Or wash it with a fan: [hl|9] nuggets and a chance of redstone.
Silk-touched ore crushes into more.

es_es.title: Aritmética de mena
text: [tip] Un hierro en bruto, un hierro triturado, más [hl|75%] de una pepita de experiencia.
[li:minecraft:iron_ingot] Fundilo: un lingote.
[li:minecraft:iron_nugget] O lavalo con ventilador: [hl|9] pepitas y chance de redstone.
La mena con toque de seda rinde más.

en_us.title: Crushing it
en_us.subtitle: Somewhere, a mountain flinched.
text: [lead] [item:create:crushing_wheel|Crushing Wheels] at maximum speed.
The stress bill is someone else's problem, right?

es_es.title: Rompiéndola
es_es.subtitle: En algún lado, una montaña se asustó.
text: [lead] [item:create:crushing_wheel|Ruedas trituradoras] a velocidad máxima.
La cuenta de estrés la paga otro, ¿no?

en_us.title: A note in the margin
text: [i|Two wheels, one purpose: whatever falls between them comes out useful. We built a whole city on that idea. —T.]

es_es.title: Una nota en el margen
text: [i|Dos ruedas, un propósito: lo que cae entre ellas sale útil. Levantamos una ciudad entera con esa idea. —T.]

en_us.title: Creative parts
text: [lead] Real power runs on water, wind and steam.
The [item:create:creative_motor|Creative Motor], tank and blaze cake cost [hl|two Luminosities] each, from Solsticio in act VI.
The Creative Crate can't be crafted.

es_es.title: Piezas creativas
text: [lead] La energía de verdad sale del agua, el viento y el vapor.
El [item:create:creative_motor|Motor creativo], el tanque y el pastel creativos cuestan [hl|dos Luminosidades] cada uno, de Solsticio en el acto VI.
El cajón creativo no se fabrica.

en_us.title: Air on tap
text: [lead] Air for Create's equipment, carried on your back.
Copper, a copper block, alloy and a shaft make a [item:create:copper_backtank|Copper Backtank].
On a spinning shaft it fills with air, faster the faster it spins.
[tip] It holds [big|900] air by default; each level of the Capacity enchantment adds [hl|300].

es_es.title: Aire a mano
text: [lead] Aire para el equipo de Create, en la espalda.
Cobre, un bloque de cobre, aleación y un eje dan un [item:create:copper_backtank|Tanque trasero de cobre].
Sobre un eje que gira se llena de aire, más rápido cuanto más rápido gira.
[tip] Guarda [big|900] de aire por defecto; cada nivel del encantamiento Capacidad suma [hl|300].

en_us.title: Deep breath
en_us.subtitle: Glub.
text: [lead] Breathe and walk underwater while the air lasts.
[li:create:copper_diving_helmet] [item:create:copper_diving_helmet|Copper Diving Helmet]: copper around a glass block. With the backtank on, you breathe.
[li:create:copper_diving_boots] [item:create:copper_diving_boots|Copper Diving Boots] sink you fast; walk and jump on the seabed.
[note] With those boots on, belts don't carry you off either.

es_es.title: Aguantá la respiración
es_es.subtitle: Glub.
text: [lead] Respirá y caminá bajo el agua mientras dure el aire.
[li:create:copper_diving_helmet] [item:create:copper_diving_helmet|Casco de Buceo de Cobre]: cobre alrededor de un vidrio. Con el tanque puesto, respirás.
[li:create:copper_diving_boots] Las [item:create:copper_diving_boots|Botas de Buceo de Cobre] te hunden rápido: caminá y saltá por el fondo.
[note] Con esas botas, las cintas tampoco te arrastran.

en_us.title: Swim with the striders
text: [lead] Fire and lava can't touch you while the air lasts.
At a smithing table, netherite upgrades turn the copper set into:
[li:create:netherite_diving_helmet] [item:create:netherite_diving_helmet|Netherite Diving Helmet]
[li] [item:create:netherite_backtank|Netherite Backtank]
[li:create:netherite_diving_boots] [item:create:netherite_diving_boots|Netherite Diving Boots]
[careful] Only with netherite leggings as well.
The helmet also lets you see inside lava.

es_es.title: Nadar con los strider
text: [lead] Ni el fuego ni la lava te tocan mientras dure el aire.
En una mesa de herrería, la mejora de netherita pasa el equipo de cobre a:
[li:create:netherite_diving_helmet] [item:create:netherite_diving_helmet|Casco de Buceo de Netherite]
[li] [item:create:netherite_backtank|Tanque trasero de netherita]
[li:create:netherite_diving_boots] [item:create:netherite_diving_boots|Botas de Buceo de Netherite]
[careful] Sólo con pantalones de netherita también.
El casco además te deja ver dentro de la lava.

en_us.title: Drink the lake
text: [lead] For filling or draining a whole lake.
A copper casing, a dried kelp block and a copper sheet make a [item:create:hose_pulley|Hose Pulley].
[li] Turned one way it lowers its hose; the other way it reels it in.
[li] Pipes on its far side feed it to fill a pool, or pull from it to drain one.
{page}
[tip] In a big enough ocean or lava lake it never runs dry and never changes the source.
How fast it moves fluid depends only on the pipes.

es_es.title: Tomarse el lago
text: [lead] Para llenar o vaciar un lago entero.
Un revestimiento de cobre, un bloque de kelp seco y una lámina de cobre dan una [item:create:hose_pulley|Polea de manguera].
[li] Girando para un lado baja la manguera; para el otro, la recoge.
[li] Los caños del otro lado la alimentan para llenar una pileta, o chupan de ella para vaciarla.
{page}
[tip] En un océano o un lago de lava bien grande nunca se agota ni cambia la fuente.
Qué tan rápido mueve fluido depende sólo de los caños.

en_us.title: A longer arm
en_us.subtitle: Boioioing.
text: [lead] Three more blocks of reach for your main hand.
Mechanical crafters build it from a [item:create:brass_hand|Brass Hand], a precision mechanism, brass and sticks.
Hold the [item:create:extendo_grip|Extendo Grip] in the off-hand.
[tip] With a backtank on, it spends air instead of durability.

es_es.title: Un brazo más largo
es_es.subtitle: Boioioing.
text: [lead] Tres bloques más de alcance para la mano principal.
Los ensambladores mecánicos lo arman con una [item:create:brass_hand|Mano de latón], un mecanismo de precisión, latón y palos.
Llevá el [item:create:extendo_grip|Agarre extensible] en la mano secundaria.
[tip] Con un tanque trasero puesto, gasta aire en vez de durabilidad.

en_us.title: Both hands
en_us.subtitle: The top shelf is no longer safe.
text: [lead] An [item:create:extendo_grip|Extendo Grip] in each hand.
[big|+5] blocks of reach. Cookie jars everywhere, beware.

es_es.title: Con las dos manos
es_es.subtitle: El estante de arriba ya no está a salvo.
text: [lead] Un [item:create:extendo_grip|Agarre extensible] en cada mano.
[big|+5] bloques de alcance. Frascos de galletitas del mundo, tiemblen.

en_us.title: Hot potato
en_us.subtitle: Fwoomp.
text: [lead] The [item:create:potato_cannon|Potato Cannon] fires food from your inventory.
Each kind its own way:
[li:minecraft:potato] Potatoes knock back hard.
[li:minecraft:carrot] Carrots and potatoes plant themselves where they land.
[li:minecraft:golden_apple] A golden apple cures a zombie villager.
[tip] With a backtank on, it spends air instead of durability.

es_es.title: Papa caliente
es_es.subtitle: Fwoomp.
text: [lead] El [item:create:potato_cannon|Lanzapatatas] dispara comida de tu inventario.
Cada una a su manera:
[li:minecraft:potato] Las papas empujan fuerte.
[li:minecraft:carrot] Zanahorias y papas se plantan donde caen.
[li:minecraft:golden_apple] Una manzana dorada cura a un aldeano zombi.
[tip] Con un tanque trasero puesto, gasta aire en vez de durabilidad.

en_us.title: Food fight
en_us.subtitle: Nobody wins. Everyone's hungry.
text: [lead] Two different vegetables, fired into each other in midair.
It was never about the aim.

es_es.title: Guerra de comida
es_es.subtitle: Nadie gana. Todos quedan con hambre.
text: [lead] Dos verduras distintas, disparadas una contra otra en el aire.
Nunca se trató de la puntería.

en_us.title: Mirror, mirror
text: [lead] Build one side and get the other free.
Anywhere in your hotbar, a [item:create:wand_of_symmetry|Wand Of Symmetry] mirrors every block you place.
[li] Use it on a surface to set or move the mirror.
[li] Sneak while using it to pick the kind of mirror.

es_es.title: Espejito, espejito
text: [lead] Construí un lado y el otro sale gratis.
En cualquier lugar de la barra, la [item:create:wand_of_symmetry|Varita de simetría] copia en espejo cada bloque que ponés.
[li] Usala sobre una superficie para poner o mover el espejo.
[li] Usala agachado para elegir el tipo de espejo.

en_us.title: A place for every tool
text: [lead] Your tools, one key away.
A cogwheel, two golden sheets, a chest and leather make a [item:create:brown_toolbox|Toolbox]; dye recolors it.
[li] [hl|8] kinds of items, up to [hl|4] stacks of each.
[li] It keeps them when you pick it up.
{page}
Within [hl|10] blocks, hold [key:create.keyinfo.toolbelt] to take a tool straight out of it; the same menu puts it back.

es_es.title: Un lugar para cada cosa
text: [lead] Tus herramientas, a una tecla.
Un engranaje, dos láminas de oro, un cofre y cuero dan una [item:create:brown_toolbox|Caja de herramientas]; el tinte le cambia el color.
[li] [hl|8] tipos de ítems, hasta [hl|4] stacks de cada uno.
[li] No los pierde cuando la levantás.
{page}
A [hl|10] bloques o menos, mantené [key:create.keyinfo.toolbelt] para sacar una herramienta directo de ella; el mismo menú la devuelve.

en_us.title: Copy, paste
text: [lead] Settings, carried from one block to another.
Alloy, paper and planks make a [item:create:clipboard|Clipboard] for notes and checklists; sneak-click to hang it on a wall.
[li:right_click] Right-click a block: copy its settings, like a filter.
[li:click] Left-click another block: paste them.
{page}
A schematicannon prints a schematic's list of materials onto it.

es_es.title: Copiar y pegar
text: [lead] La configuración, de un bloque a otro.
Aleación, papel y tablones dan un [item:create:clipboard|Portapapeles] para notas y listas; agachado y clic, lo colgás en una pared.
[li:right_click] Clic derecho en un bloque: copia su configuración, como un filtro.
[li:click] Clic izquierdo en otro bloque: la pega.
{page}
Un esquematicañón le imprime la lista de materiales de un esquema.

en_us.title: Save a building
text: [lead] Any build, saved to a file.
[li:create:empty_schematic] Paper and light blue dye: an [item:create:empty_schematic|Empty Schematic].
[li:create:schematic_and_quill] Add a feather: a [item:create:schematic_and_quill|Schematic And Quill].
Right-click two corners, stretch the faces with [key:create.keyinfo.ctrl_modifier] and the scroll wheel, then right-click again to save it.

es_es.title: Guardar un edificio
text: [lead] Cualquier construcción, guardada en un archivo.
[li:create:empty_schematic] Papel y tinte celeste: un [item:create:empty_schematic|Esquema vacío].
[li:create:schematic_and_quill] Con una pluma: un [item:create:schematic_and_quill|Esquema y pluma].
Clic derecho en dos esquinas, estirá las caras con [key:create.keyinfo.ctrl_modifier] y la rueda del mouse, y otro clic derecho lo guarda.

en_us.title: From file to paper
text: [lead] Wooden slabs on smooth stone make a [item:create:schematic_table|Schematic Table].
Put an empty schematic in and pick a file from your schematics folder.
[li:create:schematic] Out comes a [item:create:schematic|Schematic]: a hologram to move, turn and mirror before you set it in place.

es_es.title: Del archivo al papel
text: [lead] Losas de madera sobre piedra lisa dan una [item:create:schematic_table|Tabla de esquemas].
Poné un esquema vacío y elegí un archivo de tu carpeta de esquemas.
[li:create:schematic] Sale un [item:create:schematic|Esquema]: un holograma que movés, girás y espejás antes de dejarlo ubicado.

en_us.title: Print it
en_us.subtitle: Aim at the plan, not the neighbours.
text: [lead] A [item:create:schematicannon|Schematicannon] builds a placed schematic block by block.
It takes the blocks from the chests next to it.
[li:minecraft:gunpowder] Fuel: gunpowder. One piece fires [big|400] blocks by default.
{page}
Its settings choose what it may replace.
[li:create:clipboard] A clipboard or a book in its printer slot gets the list of missing materials.

es_es.title: Imprimilo
es_es.subtitle: Apuntale al plano, no a los vecinos.
text: [lead] Un [item:create:schematicannon|Esquematicañón] construye un esquema ubicado, bloque por bloque.
Saca los bloques de los cofres de al lado.
[li:minecraft:gunpowder] Combustible: pólvora. Una rinde [big|400] bloques por defecto.
{page}
Su configuración elige qué puede reemplazar.
[li:create:clipboard] Un portapapeles o un libro en la ranura de impresión recibe la lista de materiales que faltan.

en_us.title: Recipes on the wall
text: [lead] A painting and a crafting table make a [item:create:crafting_blueprint|Crafting Blueprint].
[li] Hang it up and set a recipe in each slot.
[li:right_click] Right-click a slot to craft it from what you carry.
[li] Sneak for a whole stack.

es_es.title: Recetas en la pared
text: [lead] Un cuadro y una mesa de trabajo dan un [item:create:crafting_blueprint|Plano de elaboración].
[li] Colgalo y fijá una receta en cada casilla.
[li:right_click] Clic derecho en una: la fabricás con lo que llevás encima.
[li] Agachado, un stack entero.

en_us.title: Tea break
en_us.subtitle: Motivating. Also filling.
text: [lead] Three minutes of Haste, even on a full stomach.
[li] Leaves, water and milk in a heated mixer brew tea.
[li:create:builders_tea] A spout pours [hl|250 mB] into a glass bottle: [item:create:builders_tea|Builder's Tea].

es_es.title: Pausa para el té
es_es.subtitle: Motivante. Y llena.
text: [lead] Tres minutos de Prisa, aunque estés lleno.
[li] Hojas, agua y leche en una mezcladora con calor dan té.
[li:create:builders_tea] Un surtidor le echa [hl|250 mB] a una botella: [item:create:builders_tea|Té del Constructor].

en_us.title: Sweet tooth
en_us.subtitle: A balanced diet, technically.
text: [lead] Sugar, cocoa and milk in a heated mixer melt into chocolate.
Then, from one spout:
[li:create:chocolate_glazed_berries] Chocolate on sweet berries: [item:create:chocolate_glazed_berries|Chocolate Glazed Berries].
[li:create:honeyed_apple] Honey on an apple: a [item:create:honeyed_apple|Honeyed Apple].
[li:create:sweet_roll] Milk on bread: a [item:create:sweet_roll|Sweet Roll].
{page}
[li:create:bar_of_chocolate] A press over a basin compacts chocolate into a [item:create:bar_of_chocolate|Bar of Chocolate].

es_es.title: Golosos
es_es.subtitle: Una dieta balanceada, técnicamente.
text: [lead] Azúcar, cacao y leche en una mezcladora con calor se funden en chocolate.
Después, desde un mismo surtidor:
[li:create:chocolate_glazed_berries] Chocolate sobre bayas dulces: [item:create:chocolate_glazed_berries|Bayas Bañadas en chocolate].
[li:create:honeyed_apple] Miel sobre una manzana: una [item:create:honeyed_apple|Manzana con miel].
[li:create:sweet_roll] Leche sobre pan: una [item:create:sweet_roll|Ensaimada].
{page}
[li:create:bar_of_chocolate] Una prensa sobre una cuenca compacta el chocolate en una [item:create:bar_of_chocolate|Barra de chocolate].

en_us.title: Is it time?
text: [lead] Planks, an andesite casing and a clock make a [item:create:cuckoo_clock|Cuckoo Clock].
Give it rotation and it shows the time. Its bird sings twice a day:
[li] at noon,
[li] at dusk, once you can sleep.
[careful] Gunpowder around one makes a clock that looks the same and ends its song with a bang.

es_es.title: ¿Llegó la hora?
text: [lead] Tablones, un revestimiento de andesita y un reloj dan un [item:create:cuckoo_clock|Reloj de cuco].
Con rotación muestra la hora. Su pájaro canta dos veces por día:
[li] al mediodía,
[li] al atardecer, cuando ya se puede dormir.
[careful] Con pólvora alrededor sale un reloj idéntico que termina su canción con una explosión.

en_us.title: Ring for trouble
en_us.subtitle: It hears the dark.
text: [lead] It shows the dark spots where monsters can spawn.
A block of brass on a brass sheet makes a [item:create:peculiar_bell|Peculiar Bell].
Set it over soul fire, or haunt it with a fan, and it wakes up as a [item:create:haunted_bell|Haunted Bell]. Hold it or ring it.

es_es.title: Campana de alerta
es_es.subtitle: Escucha la oscuridad.
text: [lead] Muestra los rincones oscuros donde pueden aparecer monstruos.
Un bloque de latón sobre una lámina de latón da una [item:create:peculiar_bell|Campana peculiar].
Ponela sobre fuego de almas, o embrujala con un ventilador, y despierta como [item:create:haunted_bell|Campana maldita]. En la mano o al sonar.

en_us.title: Where the zinc is
text: [lead] Zinc runs through the Overworld in veins of up to a dozen blocks.
From the deepslate up to height [hl|70].
[li:create:raw_zinc] Smelt the [item:create:raw_zinc|Raw Zinc].
[li:create:crushed_raw_zinc] Or crush it first: a crushed zinc and a chance of XP each.
[li:create:zinc_nugget] Washed with a fan: [hl|9] nuggets and sometimes gunpowder.

es_es.title: Dónde está el cinc
text: [lead] El cinc cruza el Overworld en vetas de hasta una docena de bloques.
Desde la pizarra profunda hasta la altura [hl|70].
[li:create:raw_zinc] Fundí el [item:create:raw_zinc|Cinc en Bruto].
[li:create:crushed_raw_zinc] O trituralo antes: un cinc triturado y chance de experiencia por cada uno.
[li:create:zinc_nugget] Lavado con ventilador: [hl|9] pepitas y a veces pólvora.

en_us.title: Stone with a streak
text: [lead] Striped layers underground hide Create's stones.
[li] [item:create:asurine|Asurine], [item:create:crimsite|Crimsite], [item:create:ochrum|Ochrum], [item:create:veridium|Veridium], [item:create:limestone|Limestone].
[li] In the Nether: [item:create:scoria|Scoria] and [item:create:scorchia|Scorchia].
Crushed, the colored ones give bits of zinc, iron, gold or copper.
{page}
At the stonecutter each stone comes cut, polished, as bricks or as a pillar.

es_es.title: Piedra con vetas
text: [lead] Capas rayadas bajo tierra esconden las piedras de Create.
[li] [item:create:asurine|Azurina], [item:create:crimsite|Carmesita], [item:create:ochrum|Ocre], [item:create:veridium|Veridio], [item:create:limestone|Piedra caliza].
[li] En el Nether: [item:create:scoria|Escoria] y [item:create:scorchia|Escoria oscura].
Trituradas, las de color dan pedacitos de cinc, hierro, oro o cobre.
{page}
En el cortapiedras, cada piedra sale cortada, pulida, en ladrillos o en pilar.

en_us.title: Light the workshop
en_us.subtitle: It's dark down here.
text: [lead] Somebody has to turn the lights on.
No reward: just light.

es_es.title: Prendé el taller
es_es.subtitle: Está oscuro acá abajo.
text: [lead] Alguien tiene que prender la luz.
Sin premio: sólo luz.

en_us.title: Pull the whistle
en_us.subtitle: Toot.
text: [lead] Every boiler deserves a whistle.
Nothing to build. Just steam.

es_es.title: Tirá del silbato
es_es.subtitle: Fiuuu.
text: [lead] Toda caldera se merece un silbato.
Nada que fabricar. Sólo vapor.
